# IELTS DECODED — Official Website & Academic IELTS Diagnostic Platform

> IELTS DECODED is an Academic IELTS diagnostic, self-prep, and live mentorship platform founded by Jubayer Siddiki (IELTS Overall Band 8.0 · CLB 9 · Listening 8.5 · Reading 8.5 · Writing 7.0 · Speaking 7.0). It helps IELTS candidates diagnose and fix the exact [K] Knowledge, [S] Skill, and [C] Care mistakes holding their band score at 6.0 or 6.5.

## Core Free IELTS Diagnostic Tools & Pages
- [IELTS DECODED Homepage](/): Overview of the K/S/C Mistake DNA methodology, free 38-page IELTS Band 7+ Score Rescue PDF, student proof, and mentorship programs.
- [Free AI IELTS Writing Checker & Examiner Red-Pen Desk](/diagnostic): Evaluates IELTS Writing Task 1 & Task 2 responses using the official May 2023 IELTS Public Band Descriptors (TR/TA, CC, LR, GRA) with red-pen line corrections and Band 7.5+ model rewrites.
- [Free Personalized IELTS Study Plan Builder](/study-plan): Generates a customized 7 to 90-day day-by-day IELTS preparation schedule PDF tailored to a student's current band, target band, exam date, and weakest question types.
- [IELTS DECODED Self-Prep Module Guides](/guides): 4 modular Academic IELTS self-prep PDF books — Writing (65 pages), Reading (48 pages), Speaking (59 pages), and Listening (50 pages) — with free 5-page sample chapter downloads. Priced at BDT 499 per module or BDT 1,499 for all 4 guides (with a 50% fee credit toward live programs).
- [Most Common IELTS Mistakes & Band 7.5+ Tips](/tips): Side-by-side Band 6.0 vs. Band 7.5+ mistake fixes tagged by Knowledge [K], Skill [S], and Care [C] across Writing, Reading, Speaking, and Listening.
- [Band 6.0 to 7.5+ IELTS Writing Essay Case Study](/case-study): Full line-by-line examiner red-pen breakdown of a real student Task 2 paragraph and its Band 7.5+ upgrade.
- [IELTS Band Score Calculator & Raw Score Converter](/band-calculator): Converts Listening and Academic Reading raw scores (/40) to official 0.5 band increments and calculates overall IELTS band scores.

## Live Mentorship Programs
- **12-Week Live IELTS Mentorship Batch (BDT 7,999)**: Capped at 10 students per cohort. Covers all 4 modules, 3-month step-by-step study plan, 5 full mock tests, personal line-by-line writing corrections, and weekly speaking evaluations.
- **1-to-1 Urgent Crash Course (BDT 9,999)**: Personalized private coaching built around the student's exact exam countdown with live screen-sharing essay dissections and speaking mocks.
